title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
summary: Broadcom released patches for 23 security flaws in VMware products, including a critical vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass login requirements. This matters because it gives unauthorized users full control over vulnerable systems.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses these VMware products, your IT team should apply the latest security patches.
action_it: Apply Broadcom's patches for the 23 addressed vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-123903.

title: Radware discloses breach exposing customer cloud access keys
summary: Cybersecurity company Radware suffered a data breach after an exposed management tool leaked customer cloud access keys. This matters because the exposed keys could allow unauthorized access to affected customers' cloud environments.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your organization is a Radware customer, check with your IT department to see if your cloud access keys need to be rotated.
action_it: Review cloud environments for unauthorized access, rotate any potentially exposed cloud access keys, and secure internal APIs to prevent unauthorized exposure.

title: Hackers compromise Check Point Servers in 22 organizations
summary: Hackers have broken into security management servers belonging to 22 different organizations. This matters because it gives attackers access to the systems that control network defenses.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses Check Point security systems, your IT team will handle the necessary fixes.

title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
summary: Hackers have found a way to bypass SHA pinning, a key defense method used in GitHub Actions to secure software code. This matters because it allows attackers to disguise malicious code as official tools, potentially undermining supply chain security.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses GitHub Actions or software development pipelines, your IT and development teams should review their security practices based on the latest research.
action_it: Review GitHub Actions workflows for potential bypass methods and monitor for unexpected changes or untrusted code masquerading as official checkout tools.

title: Google Researcher Shows How a Single Bit Change in .NET Files Bypassed Windows Code Integrity
summary: A Google researcher discovered a flaw where changing a single piece of data in .NET program files bypasses Windows and VirtualBox security protections. This matters because it could allow attackers to run untrusted code on a system where it should normally be blocked.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything right now. Keep your Windows operating system and Oracle VirtualBox updated as normal when patches become available.
action_it: Monitor vendor advisories from Microsoft and Oracle for updates regarding CVE-2026-87268 and apply patches as soon as they are released.

title: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
summary: An unknown attacker actively hunted for security keys and secrets in Microsoft's Azure API Management service, affecting multiple companies in Norway. Microsoft has since fixed the flaw.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses Microsoft's Azure cloud services, your IT team should review their systems.

title: Turnitin discloses cyberattack affecting customer-facing systems
summary: Turnitin disclosed a cyberattack involving unauthorized activity on some of its customer-facing systems. This matters because Turnitin is widely used by schools to check student work for plagiarism.

title: Iran-Aligned Volant Manticore Uses IPFS-Based KuboShell Backdoor in Espionage Campaigns
summary: An Iran-backed hacking group called Volant Manticore is spying on telecommunications companies, airlines, and critical infrastructure in Cyprus using a new backdoor tool. This matters because it shows attackers are finding new ways to hide their commands using decentralized file-sharing networks.

title: European Commission confirms data theft in EU Academy breach
summary: Attackers broke into the European Union's online learning platform and stole users' personal information. This matters because anyone who used the site may have had their private details exposed.

title: McDonald's Japan data breach exposes customer location information
summary: Attackers accessed a database belonging to McDonald's Japan that contained location information for smartphone app users. This matters because customer data was exposed, potentially risking their privacy.

title: Okta Links ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site
summary: Security researchers have linked a voice phishing group associated with the ShinyHunters extortion crew to a new data leak site called INCEPTION. This group uses phone scams to trick people into giving away their login credentials.

title: Police disrupt 57 illegal streaming services with 7.3 million visits
summary: Police across 11 countries have shut down 57 illegal streaming services that attracted millions of visitors annually. This action disrupts major illicit media networks and highlights ongoing international law enforcement efforts against digital piracy.

title: From Vulnerability Noise to Resilience: Rethinking Security in the AI Era
summary: RapidFort discusses how artificial intelligence is increasing software complexity and overwhelming security teams with unimportant alerts. The article highlights that using automated tools and container protection can help organizations focus on real risks.

title: New Shirudo tool uses AI to shield unpatched Linux systems from exploits
summary: OpenAI and Cisco have released an open-source tool called Shirudo that uses artificial intelligence to protect unpatched Linux systems from attacks. This helps defenders by blocking exploits temporarily while they prepare official software updates.

also_covered.title: OpenAI and Cisco Unveil AI-Assisted Linux Security Tool to Block Exploits Before Patching

title: 2027 SOC Budget Reset: 5 Priorities to Cut Costs and Reduce Cyber Risk
summary: A cybersecurity research report suggests that security operations centers can save hundreds of analyst hours by speeding up threat analysis. This matters because reducing manual work helps cut costs and lowers security risks.
